body.query: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.

raw_response.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.description AS product_description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id
ORDER BY p.description;
raw_response.query: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.

reason.answer: The query returns a deduplicated, alphabetically ordered list of product descriptions associated with recorded transactions across the fuel-site network. Because the data provides no country or location attribute for sites, a Czech Republic-specific restriction cannot be represented; the list therefore reflects all sites present in the dataset.
reason.business:
- Identify all transactions recorded in the fuel-site network.
- Attach each transaction to the product it relates to.
- Remove duplicate product names so each description appears once.
- Note: the available data does not include a country attribute for fuel sites, so a Czech Republic restriction cannot be applied; the result covers the full site network in the dataset.
- Present the distinct product descriptions in alphabetical order.
reason.technical:
## Common Table Expressions
- (not used)

## Projected Columns
- Product description only, exposed as `product_description`, since the question asks for product names rather than transactional measures.

## Source
- Transaction records joined against the product catalog so each transaction resolves to a human-readable product description.

## Joins
- Inner join between transactions and products on the shared product identifier, keeping only transactions with a known product.

## Filters
- No country-based filter is applied because the available attributes contain no country, region, or location field for fuel sites; the query therefore reflects the entire network present in the data.

## Aggregation
- Distinct selection to list each product description once.

## Sorting
- Alphabetical ordering by product description for readability.

## Result Limit
- (not used)

## Union
- (not used)
